draft_note: Calculation spec from the city-expansion handoff. Not a publishable observation: no source is archived.
utility: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Waterworks

temporary_policy_adjustments.amount_or_rule: basic charge waived in full for 13, 20 and 25 mm connections
temporary_policy_adjustments.period_note: Four months, running either May-August or June-September depending on whether the property's meter is read in an even or an odd month. The draft modelled a single month of July. The payable price is period-dependent in a way one monthly figure cannot express.
temporary_policy_adjustments.funded_by: transfer from the metropolitan general account, not from water revenue — which is why the underlying tariff is unchanged
temporary_policy_adjustments.issuer_characterisation: a temporary special measure limited to this summer
temporary_policy_adjustments.repetition_note: The same measure ran in the summer of 2025. A measure the issuer calls limited to this summer has now happened two years running. Recorded as the issuer states it, with the repetition noted.

reference_connection.designation: Tokyo publishes a basic charge per connection size; 20 mm is the ordinary single-dwelling size.

billing_formula.evidence: Stated by the Bureau for both water and sewerage; verified against three of its published totals.

basic_volume_note: The first 5 m3 a month is a basic volume INCLUDED IN THE BASIC CHARGE for connections of 25 mm or below, not an ordinary zero-rated first tier. Modelled as a zero-rate block because the arithmetic is identical, and flagged because the two are different claims — and because under the waiver the allowance survives while the charge it belongs to does not.

component_states.question: The tier table has not been read. The engine reproduces three of the Bureau's own published totals exactly using the draft structure — 147.2 yen/m3 at 24 m3, the 9,038 yen bi-monthly example, and the 5,148 yen waiver value — which constrains the tiers tightly and is not the same as reading them. Closing it needs 早見表（2か月用）(23区).
The sewerage tier table has not been read. The draft computes (560 + 7 x 110) x 1.10 = 1,463 at 15 m3 and reports an official example giving exactly that; neither has been captured.
The guidance page is captured in extract; the press release of 15 May 2026 and the notice 水道料金の基本料金の無償について（令和8年夏季）are not. Under §5.4 the payable/structural split turns entirely on the instrument.

scope_disclosures: Musashino City is not served by the Bureau and is outside the waiver.
Some bulk-metered apartment buildings are outside the waiver.
Which four months are waived depends on the property's meter-read cycle.

water_supply.reason: tier table not captured; once it is, the structural tariff is provable and the live waiver does not remove basket eligibility, because the index uses the structural price
